newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura sees growth in Polish construction sector.
newsitem.headline: Nomura sees growth in Polish construction sector.

text.p: Strong order books should help the Polish construction sector continue 10-percent real growth into the medium term, Nomura Equity Research in London said in its July East European Monthly report.

"Based on current order books, strong growth in the sector should continue well into 1998. Over the medium-term, the sector is expected to continue to grow by around 10 percent per annum in real terms," the report said.

Nomura said the 10-percent growth seemed realistic when taking into account further strong inflow of foreign direct investment, Poland's planned restructuring programmes in heavy industry and the completion of its motorway project.

Nomura said the weighted price-earnings average of eight selected main-market builders -- the five Mostostals, Budimex, Exbud and GPRD -- should fall to 13.2 this year and 10.4 next year from 17.1 in 1996.
The report was written before major flooding in Poland after which many analysts said builders could further benefit from reconstruction efforts.
